description: Validate a JSON value against a JSON Schema (draft-07 subset). Supports type, required, properties, items, enum, const, pattern, format (email/uri/date), minimum/maximum, minLength/maxLength, minItems/maxItems, uniqueItems, additionalProperties, anyOf, allOf, oneOf. Returns all validation errors with dot-notation paths.

schema.description: The JSON Schema — a JSON string, or the schema object itself.

value.description: The JSON value to validate — a JSON string, or the value itself.

name: json_schema_validate
